reason: This rewrites the core iteration logic of PopulateTermEntries to only include terms present in field.TermContentItemIds, which likely breaks the editor's full checkbox tree rendering (used to select/deselect any term) by limiting the term list to already-selected items, affecting all sites using taxonomy fields.
